subject: Create Layer 1 Pydantic I/O models
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/models/schema.py` with Pydantic input/output models for Layer 1 schema discovery tools.

Models to create:

**Output models:**
- `SchemaInfo`: name, owner, table_count, is_system
- `ListSchemasOutput`: schemas (list[SchemaInfo]), count
- `TableInfo`: name, type (TABLE/VIEW), record_count, column_count, store_type (COLUMN/ROW), is_column_table
- `ListTablesOutput`: tables (list[TableInfo]), schema_name, count
- `ColumnInfo`: name, data_type, length, scale, nullable, default_value, position, comment
- `IndexInfo`: name, columns (list[str]), is_unique, index_type
- `ConstraintInfo`: name, constraint_type (PK/UNIQUE/CHECK), columns (list[str])
- `DescribeTableOutput`: table_name, schema_name, columns, indexes, constraints, is_view
- `SampleRowsOutput`: table_name, schema_name, columns, rows, row_count, total_count

**Input models** (as needed for tool parameter validation):
- Input validation for `limit` ranges, `name_pattern` format, etc.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All output models defined with correct field types
- [ ] Models use strict Pydantic v2 syntax
- [ ] `store_type` field captures COLUMN vs ROW distinction
- [ ] `is_view` flag in DescribeTableOutput for view-specific behavior
- [ ] All models serializable to JSON for MCP transport

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Optional fields (default_value, comment) handle None correctly
- [ ] Empty lists for indexes/constraints when not requested

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Model instantiation with valid data
• Unit: Model serialization to dict/JSON
• Unit: Validation rejects invalid field values

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.1, 9.2
